prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: crayon illustration. Texture family: soft wax crayon grain with layered strokes, visible pigment buildup, gentle rubbing and uneven hand-drawn mark variation. Palette: bright aquatic blues, fresh greens, sandy yellows, warm oranges, soft sky tones, and earthy browns with playful but natural saturation for underwater and shoreline environments. Line treatment: bold hand-drawn crayon contours with overlapping colored strokes, simplified scientific forms, and expressive texture while keeping anatomy readable. Lighting: warm natural daylight with soft underwater diffusion and gentle highlights on wet surfaces. Avoid: No enclosing pages or entry-object masks; no embedded text or unsupported factual imagery; no fantasy fish with unrelated powers. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. [VISUAL_CONTRACT:material_anchor_v2] Fill the canvas with a neutral material/palette sample, not a framed page, book, landscape, gateway, inset illustration or host.
